name: Welcome To... Chichester 1 : The Spy of America and the Long Vacation
source:
Re-imaged and expanded story of Welcome To... Chichester 1 test visual novel

After having most of her organisation destroyed by the protagonist, Grendel Jinx tries to find a way to safely rebuilding it without constant "interruptions" by the protagonist's rival organisation.

Discovering that he will be soon be going on holiday, Grendel decides to surreptitiously modify his plans, and to go along with him, not only to start recruiting new agents, and to have a bit of fun - preferably at his expense - but to also end a forgotten case from her past, as well as trying to fix her own organisations problems
translation:
《欢迎来到……奇切斯特1：美国间谍与漫长假期》是测试版视觉小说的重制扩展。主角摧毁了格伦德尔·金克斯的大部分组织后，她试图在主角敌对组织不断“干扰”的情况下安全重建组织。

发现主角即将去度假后，格伦德尔决定暗中修改他的计划并与他同行：她不仅想招募新特工、找点乐子（最好还是以捉弄他为乐），还想了结自己过去的一桩遗忘案件，并解决自己组织的问题。
